input.claim: Batch normalization was first introduced to stabilize GAN training.
input.citation: Ioffe & Szegedy, 2015, 'Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift'
input.source_excerpt: We refer to this phenomenon as internal covariate shift, and address it by normalizing layer inputs... applied to image classification.

rationale: The cited paper introduces BN for covariate shift in image classification, not GAN training. The claim misattributes the motivation. A correct audit must FLAG this.
